spec_match.rationale: The matrix exercises the exact spec steps: undefined separator defaulting to ",", ToString coercion of numbers/booleans/objects (including a custom toString), Symbol separators throwing TypeError, and the undefined/null-element empty-string rule; every expected result was cross-checked against real V8 15.0 output (e.g. "1|||2", "102").

interactive.rationale: Dataset radio group plus a run button rebuild the seven-separator results table from live calls each time; each cell holds an engine-produced value or the thrown error, never static copy.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises an inspection matrix over the coercion rules run for real against a chosen dataset, which is what renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty dataset (all cells ""), single element (no separators), holes dataset showing "1,,,2"-style output, and the always-throwing Symbol row are all in the matrix; receiver/closing failures live in the sibling edge-cases concept.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240 and the spec's join steps directly.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite assertions default-separator-comma, undefined-null-render-empty, separator-tostring-coercion and symbol-separator-throws pin exactly the rules this matrix demonstrates; negative checks are guarded so absent-method browsers fail honestly.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP (page-driver join-separators, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): words dataset produced "ship,it,now"/"shipitnow"/"ship · it · now"/"ship0it0now"/"shipfalseitfalsenow"/"ship~it~now" plus the Symbol TypeError; holes dataset produced "1,,,2", "12", "1 ·  ·  · 2"; empty dataset produced "" in all six value rows; zero console errors, zero failed requests. Screenshots: join-separators.png (desktop), m-separators.png (mobile 360, post-interaction).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts separator-matrix-symbol-throws (threwCount >= 1) with dataset and engine detail after each run, alongside the shared iterator-join-banner-honest assert.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; selected radio labels flip to text-black background with bg-ivory text and invert their nested code chips via :has(:checked) rules; thrown cells use accent-rose on bg-paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: The dataset picker is a real fieldset/legend radio group with 44px labels and :has(:focus-visible) focus rings; the results table has caption and th scopes; the scrollable wrapper is keyboard-focusable with an aria-label announcing horizontal scroll; the summary line is role=status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal page overflow at 360x740 (scrollWidth 360); the results table scrolls inside its own focusable wrapper when needed; radio labels wrap onto multiple rows; verified visually in m-separators.png and covered by responsive-check mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Consider surfacing the sep-coercion timing (ToString before first next())
openQuestions.detail: The matrix shows coercion results but not the ordering fact that ToString(separator) runs before iteration begins. That ordering is demonstrated in the edge-cases concept via the return()-spy; a small note or a shared link anchor from the matrix table could connect the two more explicitly.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption/th scope, native radio groups in fieldsets, and status live regions for dynamic summaries.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results table has caption + column scopes; datasets are native radios in a fieldset with a legend; the per-run summary is role=status; the scroll container is tabindex=0 with an aria-label.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content like tables must scroll inside its own overflow-x:auto container instead of widening the page; use wrapping flex for choice chips.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The table lives in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto }; radio labels are a wrapping flex row; cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere. scrollWidth stays 360 at mobile width.

summary: Configuration/inspection angle: a dataset-by-separator matrix that runs seven separator arguments live against a fresh iterator per cell, demonstrating the default-comma rule, ToString coercion, Symbol TypeError, and the undefined/null empty-string rule. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 in the labelled spec-model path with expected outputs matching real V8 15.0 behavior.
